title: Rounded cylinder
spec: Create a new coordinate system and set the Euler angles to zero degrees for all axes. Set the translation vector to 0.0298, 0.0294, and 0.6. Next, draw the first two-dimensional sketch on a single face. Within this face, draw a single loop, and within this loop, draw a circle. Position the center of the circle at coordinates 0.0706, 0.0706, and set the radius to 0.0706. Apply a scaling factor of 0.1411 to the entire two-dimensional sketch. Rotate the scaled sketch using the Euler angles defined in the coordinate system and translate it using the translation vector. Extrude the transformed sketch along the normal direction by 0.1 units, ensuring no extrusion occurs in the opposite direction. Perform a boolean operation to create a new solid body from this extrusion. The final dimensions of the rounded cylinder will be 0.1411198 in length, 0.1411198 in width, and 0.1 in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system transformation
translation_vector = (0.0298, 0.0294, 0.6)
euler_angles = (0.0, 0.0, 0.0)

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").center(0.0706, 0.0706).circle(0.0706)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.1)

# Apply the coordinate system transformation
cylinder = cylinder.translate(translation_vector).rotate((0, 0, 0), (1, 0, 0), euler_angles[0]) \
                         .rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 1, 0), euler_angles[1]) \
                         .rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 1), euler_angles[2])

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder
